enemy-050-korari-stalker.name: Korari Stalker
enemy-050-korari-stalker.continuityDecision: Original Tantalus Frontier fauna. Korari is retained only as a location name from the licensed Aliens versus Predator 2 continuity; no published creature named or modeled as the Korari Stalker was found. The project design must not import a creature from another franchise.

sources.use: Setting/name continuity only. It grants no visual authority for the Stalker and must not be used as a creature model sheet.

researchNegativeFinding.queryScope: licensed or primary Aliens versus Predator 2 material relevant to Korari
researchNegativeFinding.result: Korari is documented as a location in AVP2 continuity; no licensed external Korari Stalker character/model was identified.
researchNegativeFinding.designConsequence: Keep PROJECT_ORIGINAL / NO_EXTERNAL_MODEL and do not invent an external franchise attribution.

v56Predecessors.role: project-owned identity predecessor; sole positive visual authority
project-owned normalized predecessor; preserve identity, do not copy frames

enemy-050-korari-stalker.designLock: PROJECT_ORIGINAL / NO_EXTERNAL_MODEL: original Tantalus Frontier low forest quadruped predator, strict right profile, wedge head with natural lateral eye and sensors, one jaw, four supple limbs, charcoal/moss organic hide with bark patterning, sparse dim cyan flank photophores and one long flexible non-bladed balance tail. Korari is setting context only. Exclude xenomorph, Yautja, technological and borrowed-franchise anatomy.

clips.lockedMotion: Eight grounded phases: low alert breath, lateral sensor focus, restrained tail counterbalance, subtle photophore pulse and seamless return; no translation.
Eight chronological low stalk/run phases with four distinct limbs, alternating contacts, supple spine and tail counterbalance; seamless root cycle.
Eight chronological phases: compress, fix target right, coil hindquarters, short pounce, single-jaw bite/foreclaw contact, follow-through, land and guarded recovery.
Eight irreversible phases: lethal impact, sensory recoil, forelimb failure, torso fall, tail loses tension, flank contact, final settle and motionless terminal pose.

acceptanceGates: 4 sheets, each exactly 1774x887 PNG, 4x2 and eight individually authored row-major poses
32/32 cells face right and contain one whole Stalker without crop, overlap or boundary contact
one head, one natural jaw, four limbs, one flexible tail, natural eye/sensors and sparse flank photophores remain invariant
rigid torso scale, shoulder height and root line remain coherent across clips
transparent RGBA or uniform pure #FF00FF chroma only; no scene, shadow, text, grid or watermark
reviewer confirms original project fauna and rejects xenomorph, Yautja or external-franchise borrowing

designDetails.silhouette: Low forest quadruped predator with a project-original feline/reptilian synthesis: supple separated limbs, wedge head, visible natural lateral eye/sensory organs, long flexible non-bladed balance tail and low stalking spine.
designDetails.palette: Charcoal and moss-green scaly/velvety surface with bark-like broken patterning; sparse dim cyan photophores confined beneath the flank, never a full neon glow.
designDetails.surface: Organic hide blending fine scales and short velvet texture, subtle bark camouflage, natural scars and dirt. No biomechanical ribs, resin carapace or technological cloak effect.
designDetails.anatomy: One wedge head, visible natural eye/sensors, one jaw, four distinct limbs, animal respiration and one flexible balance tail. No XX121 or Yautja anatomy.
designDetails.orientation: strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in every pose; muzzle, eye, gait and tail flow read laterally, head never addresses the viewer
designDetails.scale: Runtime envelope inherited from V56 override: 176 x 88 logical pixels, long low quadruped. Preserve one rigid torso length and shoulder height across all clips.
designDetails.grounding: Supporting paws share one root line. Tail can counterbalance but cannot become a fifth support or cross cell boundaries.
prohibitions: xenomorph dome, inner jaw, acid, dorsal tubes, blade tail or biomechanical anatomy
Predator/Yautja armor, dreadlocks, mask, plasma technology or active camouflage
recolored Earth panther or recognizable creature from another franchise
extra limbs, missing natural eye, weaponized tail or equipment
front-facing or left-facing head, perspective turn, duplicate pose or silhouette drift
